en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a rural road curving past a large three‑storey villa with decorative gables, labelled 'Villa Ida'. The house stands on the right side of the image with fields and a few outbuildings, while a dense forest borders the road on the left. Hills of a wooded mountain range rise in the background. Printed German text appears at the top identifying the location in the Ore Mountains of Saxony.
